description: Convert a Brazilian bank statement PDF (extrato bancário) into OFX for an accounting system, CSV and Excel. The entries are summed and checked against the balances printed in the statement; files are only written when the balance reconciles. Password-protected PDFs need `password` (or `cpf` to try the banks' usual passwords). Each converted statement counts once against the monthly quota of the user's pdfvera plan; check_only never counts.

check_only.description: Only check, write no files and use no quota

cpf.description: Account holder's CPF, to try the banks' usual passwords

output_dir.description: Folder for the result files; default: the PDF's folder

pdf_path.description: Path of the statement PDF on this computer

profile.description: Accounting system the OFX is for

name: convert_bank_statement
title: Brazilian bank statement PDF to OFX, CSV and Excel
